settings.heading: Get a Trade
settings.text: Event planners, venues, photographers and retailers can apply for a trade account: standing rate cards, volume discounts, and Net 30 invoicing once you've completed a few hires.

settings.title: Volume discounts
settings.text: 10% off at 5+ pieces, 15% at 10+, and 20% off everything once you've booked with us four times in a year.

settings.title: Net 30 invoicing
settings.text: Approved accounts are invoiced after the event instead of paying up front, with the deposit waived after three completed hires.

settings.title: A standing rate card
settings.text: No re-quoting for repeat bookings. Your rates are set once and hold for every order on the account.

settings.title: Priority on tight timelines
settings.text: Trade accounts get first call on availability when a booking comes in under our usual lead time.

settings.heading: What a trade account gets you
Apply for a Trade Account.
settings.heading_accent: We Review Every Application by Hand.
settings.text: Trade accounts get standing rate cards, volume discounts and Net 30 invoicing once you've completed a few hires. Tell us about your business and we'll set you up.
settings.success_text: Thanks — we review applications within 2 business days and will email you directly.
settings.disclaimer: Approval isn't automatic. We may ask a follow-up question before your account is upgraded.
